page_title: PIS 1-3 SAS | Pisa v Sassuolo 31/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+6' Sassuolo quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90+6' Luca Lipani (Sassuolo) latches onto a loose ball inside the box, but his first-time strike at goal is blocked by a defender. Sassuolo have been awarded a corner kick.
90+1' Rafiu Durosinmi (Pisa) latches on to a superb cross into the box and plants a header well wide of the right post.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' Rafiu Durosinmi (Pisa) meets an accurate cross in the box and steers a fine header towards the net. The goalkeeper has to react quickly to keep the ball out.
86' A cross from a corner kick by Sassuolo is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
85' Alberto Gilardino has decided to substitute Samuele Angori and he is replaced by Calvin Stengs (Pisa).
84' Here comes a substitution. Domenico Berardi is given a rest as he is replaced by Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo).
84' Here comes the VAR decision. Referee Alberto Arena decides there was no infringement by Arijanet Muric (Sassuolo) and the game can continue.
81' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident from earlier. This could be a red card for Arijanet Muric (Sassuolo)! Let's see what he decides.
80' Rafiu Durosinmi (Pisa) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while in possession of the ball.
79' Alberto Arena shows a yellow card to Luca Moro (Sassuolo) for his blatant foul.
79' Half-chance! Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) plays a pass into the box, but Simone Scuffet reacts well to snuff out the attack.
78' Pisa can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
75' Idrissa Toure (Pisa) has tested the patience of referee Alberto Arena and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
73' The referee allows time for a substitution. Andrea Pinamonti will be replaced by Luca Moro (Sassuolo).
73' A substitution has been made. Ismael Kone is replaced by Luca Lipani (Sassuolo).
73' Here is a change. Armand Lauriente is going off and Fabio Grosso gives the last tactical orders to Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo).
70' Substitution. Stefano Moreo makes his way off the pitch and Filip Stojilkovic (Pisa) comes on as his replacement.
66' What a wasted chance that is! A precise cross into the box found Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo), whose header floated just over the bar.
66' The Sassuolo players’ joy was short-lived as the original decision is reversed after a VAR review by referee Alberto Arena. NO PENALTY!
65' Celebrations by Sassuolo are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.
64' The game has begun to heat up. Matteo Tramoni (Pisa) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
64' Alberto Arena blows his whistle for a foul after Matteo Tramoni (Pisa) hacks down one of his opponents. The referee's verdict is crystal clear. A penalty is awarded to Sassuolo!
62' Rosen Bozhinov (Pisa) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Alberto Arena had an easy-decision to make.
58' 1 - 3 What a hit! Ismael Kone (Sassuolo) shows good composure inside the box to fire a first-time shot inside the left post. 1:3.
58' Poor challenge! Rafiu Durosinmi (Pisa) is penalised for tripping and Alberto Arena blows his whistle.
57' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
56' Sassuolo work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

56' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the right post. Simone Scuffet is alert and denies him with a nice save.

55' Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.

51' 1 - 2 Michel Aebischer (Pisa) gets to the ball on the edge of the box and fires in a first-time shot without any hesitation. The strike is excellent and goes inside the left post. He couldn't have done it any better. 1:2.
50' Sebastian Walukiewicz (Sassuolo) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
48' Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa) fails to score from the rebound as the goalkeeper stops his effort from hitting the net.
46' A dangerous looking corner kick from Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) is cleared to safety by the defence.
46' Alberto Gilardino makes a half-time substitution. Felipe Loyola (Pisa) comes on in place of Henrik Meister.
46' Alberto Gilardino has made a change at the break. Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa) has come on in place of Simone Canestrelli.
46' Half-time substitution. Marius Marin (Pisa) is replaced by Rafiu Durosinmi.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' 0 - 2 Own goal! Antonio Caracciolo (Pisa) suffers a good deal of misfortune as he accidentally puts a pass from one of the attacking players into his own net. The score is 0:2.
45+1' The linesman points to the corner flag, Sassuolo are going to take it.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
42' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Ismael Kone (Sassuolo) was quite harsh and Alberto Arena didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
42' Idrissa Toure (Pisa) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.

33' That's unlucky! Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) side steps a tackle after receiving a pass, advances then hits a booming shot from mid-range which only rises at the last second to fly just over the bar.
32' Idrissa Toure (Pisa) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
31' Pisa seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.

25' 0 - 1 An amazing individual effort from Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball into the right side of the goal and makes it 0:1. Simone Scuffet was helpless.
25' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
23' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
21' Alberto Arena blows his whistle as Matteo Tramoni (Pisa) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
20' Michel Aebischer (Pisa) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
20' Henrik Meister (Pisa) is flagged for offside.
20' Michel Aebischer (Pisa) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
17' Matteo Tramoni (Pisa) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post.
17' A pass from Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) is intercepted by Simone Scuffet and the move breaks down.
16' Idrissa Toure (Pisa) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
15' Neat passing move from Sassuolo in order to create new attacking opportunities.
14' Antonio Caracciolo (Pisa) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Alberto Arena has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
13' Stefano Moreo (Pisa) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
10' Sassuolo are bossing possession of the ball and make numerous short passes, but they finally lose possession after an error.
8' An attempted cross from Simone Canestrelli (Pisa) is cleared.
7' A clever short pass gives Samuele Angori (Pisa) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball well wide of the right post.
6' The foul by Michel Aebischer (Pisa) was seen by Alberto Arena who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
5' Rosen Bozhinov (Pisa) has a goal ruled out for offside!
4' The resulting corner from Matteo Tramoni (Pisa) is cleared by the defence.

4' Stefano Moreo (Pisa) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort. The referee blows his whistle, Pisa are awarded a corner kick.
3' Arijanet Muric is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Simone Canestrelli (Pisa). Easy save!
1' Simone Canestrelli (Pisa) commits a rough foul. Alberto Arena stops the game and makes a call.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Pisa will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Alberto Arena.
Show lineups The starting lineups for this match have been revealed.
Show lineups
